name: Ameresco, Inc.
description: Ameresco Inc is an energy infrastructure solutions provider dedicated to helping customers reduce costs, enhance resilience, and decarbonize to net zero in the energy transition. Its comprehensive portfolio includes implementing smart energy efficiency solutions, upgrading aging infrastructure, and developing, constructing, and operating distributed energy resources. Its solutions range from upgrades to facility's energy infrastructure to the development, construction and operation of renewable energy plants combined with tailored financial solutions. Its segments include North America Regions, U.S. Federal, Renewable Fuels, Europe, and Others. The majority of the revenue is derived from North America Regions segment.
